def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    hr=[r for r in range(h) if all(x==3 for x in g[r])]
    vc=[c for c in range(w) if all(g[r][c]==3 for r in range(h))]
    hr,vc=hr[0],vc[0]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]==3: continue
            u=abs(r-hr)-1; v=abs(c-vc)-1
            if (v%2==1 and u<=v) or (u%2==1 and v<=u):
                out[r][c]=4
    return out
